result.instructions: Tools for MillionVerifier, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many MillionVerifier verification credits remain?"; "Verify this email after I confirm the credit charge."; "Upload this list for bulk verification after I confirm the credit charge.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MillionVerifier data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run millionverifier_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run millionverifier_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run millionverifier_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. millionverifier_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: millionverifier_credits
tools.title: Check MillionVerifier credits
tools.description: Read remaining MillionVerifier credits without starting verification.

tools.name: millionverifier_verify_email
tools.title: Verify an email with MillionVerifier
tools.description: Verify one email using MillionVerifier's real-time API. Can spend credits and requires confirm:true. The vendor timeout is 10 seconds; this charged GET is never retried. Unknown/catch-all results do not establish deliverability. If the response is lost, check the dashboard before submitting again.

tools.name: millionverifier_upload_file
tools.title: Start MillionVerifier bulk verification
tools.description: Create and upload a CSV of 1–1,000 emails for bulk verification. Can start a billable job and spend credits; requires confirm:true. Returns a file ID for millionverifier_file_info. Never retries or automatically polls. A timed-out submission may still create a job; check the dashboard before repeating it. Download individual results in MillionVerifier.

tools.name: millionverifier_file_info
tools.title: Read MillionVerifier bulk file status
tools.description: Read an existing bulk file's verification status, progress and aggregate result counts using its file ID. Includes failed/canceled jobs without starting, stopping or re-verifying anything. Does not download individual email results. Wait between polls.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with MillionVerifier
prompts.description: What you can do with MillionVerifier here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_available_verification_credits
prompts.title: Check available verification credits
prompts.description: Read the remaining MillionVerifier credit balance before starting an individual check or bulk upload.

prompts.name: screen_a_new_email_address
prompts.title: Screen a new email address
prompts.description: Confirm credit usage to verify one email and review its result. Unknown and catch-all outcomes do not establish that a mailbox is deliverable.

prompts.name: submit_a_list_for_bulk_verification
prompts.title: Submit a list for bulk verification
prompts.description: Confirm credit usage to upload a CSV of 1–1,000 addresses. Keep the returned file ID, then check its progress and aggregate verification counts, waiting between checks.

prompts.name: review_an_existing_bulk_job
prompts.title: Review an existing bulk job
prompts.description: Use a known file ID to inspect progress, aggregate result counts and failed or canceled status. Read individual email results in the MillionVerifier dashboard.
